reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and with a 10-month-old I'd also be paying for a kid who is too small to use most of it. I'd maybe try one drop-in once it opens, but I wouldn't commit to a membership sight unseen.
objection: $59 a month for something I might use twice a month, when free options already fill the week. I can afford it, but I can't see paying it every month.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, or a real quiet work-friendly setup (good Wi-Fi, a spot where I can see the toddler) that I've tried and found I'd use weekly. Then $49 founding would be fine.
